description.zh: 路由算法表达式，您可以参考DMS的文档配置路由算法表达式，详情请参见[路由算法配置](~~107594~~)。
description.en: The routing algorithm expression. For more information about how to configure a routing algorithm expression, see [Configure a routing algorithm](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/configure-a-routing-algorithm).

description.zh:
路由算法唯一键。

> - 您可以自定义路由算法唯一键，无任何约束格式。
> - 同一个逻辑表下的路由算法配置唯一键不能重复。
description.en:
The unique key of the routing algorithm. 

> - You can create a custom unique key for the routing algorithm. No requirements are imposed on custom unique keys.
> - The unique key of the routing algorithm in the same logical table must be unique.

description.zh: 逻辑库的表ID，可通过调用接口[ListLogicTables](~~141875~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the logical table. You can call the [ListLogicTables](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/listlogictables) operation to query the ID of the logical table.

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/data-management-service/latest/getuseractivetenant) operation to query the tenant ID.

title.zh: 逻辑表中配置路由算法
